_comment: The project's KPI: the design's minimum clock period, one row per
measured run. It is the largest of parent_ps and each block's period in
blocks: the design is only as fast as its slowest part, and the parent
is one part like any block. Add a row when a change moves it, run
kpi.py, commit both.
parent_ps is the parent's SDC period minus the worst slack of its
reg2reg group at global route, the only group that can fail timing
closure; see .claude/commands/odb-debug.md for how to ask a checkpoint
for it, and .claude/skills/macro-constraints for why the other groups
are not the number. The parent's reg2reg group does not see the paths
inside a block's abstract. Ask for the group by name: on
VecRegionModule the overall worst slack is -2006 ps and belongs to
another group, while reg2reg is -1564 ps, and only the second one is
the period.
blocks is the same measurement on each hardened block alone, at its own
place stage through <block>_place_odb_debug, against an ideal clock.
Rows without blocks give only a lower bound on the design's period.
The target is 591 ps at global route: XiangShan's 333 ps on 7 nm is
41.1 fanouts of four at the published ASAP7 FO4 of 8.1 ps, and 41.1
FO4 of the library this flow times with (RVT at FF, 14.37 ps) is
591 ps. The SDC synthesises at 0.8 of it, 473 ps; period_fo4_test
checks the arithmetic. Rows before 2026-09-26's second XSTile run
were measured with the SDC at 800 ps. When the period approaches the
target, this file gains the CoreMark and power columns and the study
reconnects; until then the design does not depend on it.

Patch 0135 times a global-route abstract with the route's parasitics: MemBlock's lqIdx-to-pdest arc was 6.9 ns with placement parasitics and is 1.84 ns, as MemBlock times itself; the parent was 7,855 ps without it. The register files are macros with their own clock trees (#1257, #1265), and the parent's CTS takes 40 min where run 16's took about 10 h. Every earlier row's block abstracts carry placement parasitics. Parent place 3.9 h, global route 45 min at 98 GB

parent.what: From the integer region's load-queue index register out through MemBlock (its 1.84 ns input-to-output arc) and back into the integer load issue queue's wakeup: a round trip through a hardened block in one cycle.

Frontend.what: Inside the FTQ: one main-BTB entry's hit flag to a TAGE entry's useProvider bit, both in the training metadata the FTQ sends back to the branch predictor.

MemBlock.what: DCache main pipeline, stage 1: the request's virtual address to the address pin of a data-bank SRAM macro; index bits travelling to a memory.

CoupledL2.what: The L2 directory's stage-3 metadata state register to the write-enable of the directory's metadata SRAM: a state decision gating a memory write.

FltRegionModule.what: The floating-point register file macro's read port to the FP adder's source-operand register: read data out of the register-file macro.

VecRegionModule.what: The vector floating-point divider's quotient register to the vector multiply-add's operand register, in the same issue pipe.

FltRegionModule->VecRegionModule.what: An FP issue-queue entry valid into the vector issue queue's age matrix: block to block through the parent. 52 stages, 832 ps in repeaters.

FltRegionModule->XSTile.what: The FP issue queues' entry valids, through out_toDispatch_canAccept, into ctrlBlock's decode buffer: backpressure from the FP region to dispatch, crossing from one hardened block into the parent. 69 stages, 1,026 ps in repeaters.

MemBlock->XSTile.what: A load unit's stage-1 valid out of MemBlock into an integer store-data issue queue's dequeue. 81 stages, 1,709 ps in repeaters: almost all distance.

XSTile->FltRegionModule.what: ctrlBlock's ROB flush redirect into the FP register file's read address. 70 stages, 1,722 ps in repeaters.

XSTile->MemBlock.what: ctrlBlock's ROB flush redirect into MemBlock's instruction-fetch bridge queue pointer. 52 stages, 1,361 ps in repeaters.

XSTile->VecRegionModule.what: The integer region's ALU pipeline register (fuType) into the vector region's issue pipe valid: the parent's dispatch steering into a hardened block. 93 stages, 1,151 ps in repeaters.

parent.what: Decode into the memory dependence predictor: ctrlBlock's decode-buffer valid bit to a strict bit read from the store-set identifier table (memCtrl.ssit). 60 cell stages, 1,044 ps of them repeaters.
